description: This PHP class 'Book' in the 'Todaymade\Daux\Format\HTMLFile' namespace manages the generation of an HTML book/documentation, including navigation, table of contents, cover page, and pages, based on a directory tree structure and configuration.

classes.name: Book
classes.description: A class responsible for generating an HTML documentation book from a directory structure and configuration, including navigation, table of contents, cover, and pages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Book with a directory tree and configuration.

methods.name: getStyles
methods.description: Builds inline CSS styles by concatenating contents from theme CSS files.

methods.name: getPageUrl
methods.description: Generates a unique page URL hash identifier based on the page URL.

methods.name: buildNavigation
methods.description: Recursively constructs navigation entries from the directory tree.

methods.name: renderNavigation
methods.description: Renders the navigation array into nested HTML list structure.

methods.name: generateTOC
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the table of contents.

methods.name: generateCover
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the cover page using title, tagline, and author from config.

methods.name: generatePages
methods.description: Assembles the HTML content for all pages added to the book.

methods.name: addPage
methods.description: Adds a page and its content to the book.

methods.name: generateHead
methods.description: Creates the complete HTML head section including styles.

methods.name: generateBody
methods.description: Creates the HTML body, including cover, TOC, and pages.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Wraps head and body in a complete HTML document.
